name: noise girl
source:
kitty just wants to draw their webcomic and go on dates with cuties,  but they never know when a debilitating noise attack will knock them on their butt! is it a mental illness triggered by something that happened to them when they were younger? or is it a curse laid upon them by the noise girl who comes out of tv static?

[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/noise-girl]itch.io[/url]]
